original.description: Belgian troops blocking a road at Liège against the German advance, 1914, as reproduced in "Der Krieg 1914-19 in Wort und Bild".
original.photographer: not attributed on the plate ("No attribution")
original.date: 1914 (subject); the record gives the plate as 1919
original.archive: Wikimedia Commons; the record cites "Der Krieg 1914-19 in Wort und Bild", Deutsches Verlagshaus Bong & Co., Berlin, 1919

colorization.status: not colorized. Recommendation: leave as it is — the registry already has one colorized Belgian infantry photograph (Herstal), and a second would be a colour claim too many on a source this thin.

content_policy: ok — a barricade and troops, no gore
caption: Belgian troops blocking a road at Liège, 1914 — as a German illustrated history printed it after the war.
credit: Original photograph: photographer not attributed; published in "Der Krieg 1914-19 in Wort und Bild", Deutsches Verlagshaus Bong & Co., Berlin, 1919; via Wikimedia Commons; public domain.
notes: Verified 2026-08-24 against the Commons file record via the MediaWiki API. CAUTION for the image review (sand-y0u.7), the same one that attaches to the Herstal photograph already in the registry: the caption is a publisher’s, five years after the event, and 1914 illustrated histories re-captioned freely. Use only if the pack needs a second Belgian image at Liège.
